description: agent-workflows: load the working conventions at session start and gate git commit and push on a passing cw task verify

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/global/AGENTS.md"; if ! command -v cw >/dev/null 2>&1; then cat "$f"; printf '%s\n' 'agent-workflows: the commit and push verify gate is inactive because cw was not found on PATH. Install cw with `go install github.com/belevtsev/agent-workflows/v3/cmd/cw@v3.0.0-rc.1` (Go 1.27 or newer) or from the release archive: https://github.com/belevtsev/agent-workflows/blob/main/docs/operations.md#get-cw'; elif out=$(cw hook session-start --instructions "$f" --cache "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$out" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$out"; else cat "$f"; fi
command -v cw >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; cw hook pre-publish; exit 0
